name: /daily-end
description: End of day: reflect, capture what happened, close the day with a rich event

steps.action: Prepare a project-local end-of-day report read-only
steps.context: Use the current repository only: local Git metadata, existing local events, TODO, and interrupts. Do not scan or update another repository and do not read credential files.

steps.action: Draft the event body in chat memory only
steps.context: Draft a factual local narrative with accomplishments, decisions, problems, current state, and next work. Show it in chat. Do not create a file in /tmp or anywhere else. A chat draft is not a save or checkpoint.

options: B) Save this exact summary as a project-local event

steps.context: If recording is selected, use create_event.sh under the existing ordinary local-save authorization. It saves the exact narrative and refreshes only generated context and its local coverage receipt. Report both results. If exit 3, keep the saved event and retry only refresh_rollups.py --apply. Do not edit durable memory automatically, create a lifecycle checkpoint, or sync automatically.
